content: O zoola ka Yeso ka eze azaa oyara
Nangka Yeso ka laka aromo ane kurkǝnǝng, naka zale oyara aa ka cikǝ a saname. Na atoma kai deya kai,
aka bore o baala one na.
O wala o kona oleba

content.text: “Ana okona olebaa aromo aaka ne rose o sawa one a nyimi o tare Ashili,
aza o bena togomo te shili taate nea te.
Ana okona oleba ana o caro anyong,
Ana okona olebaa ana o nata ukpwei,
Ana okona olebaa andaaka neya kona ekomo ka lewe le cikǝ o sangsang,
Ana okona olebaa andaaka ne kone egonegone,
Ana okona olebaa andaaka neya sangsang a nyimia nyong,
Ana okona olebaa andaaka ne gere o cikǝ o cammo,
obena ayo rara ne na ayana Ashili.
Ana okona olebaa andaaka a nyana ne azaa be sangsang bene,
obena togomo te shili taa tene te.

content: Ana okona olebaa ying awere aka aromo ne eske ying, ane nyalang ka ying ane kang beya kombela rendaza ma buru aza oying, obena ying e tareng.
Konana oleba e zante ajǝng, o bena bengmǝ bee ying yo gongha aa cak azaa shili, nyimia aromome ne gǝǝzǝ ana obeya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili kane kaana ying.”
O baala azaa ogalu ka masanto
Yingnga ogalu makeke maana. A ogalu wa arnang ka olento owai, eya ayo ya ka wa kang olento? Wa itǝ wata kang ya ka edang ne, soona a oke wai a itǝzǝ ne.
Yingnga masanto ma lerambo. Apeng aka a sowa ai azaa ka zalo, a era ta baasa ne.
Nyimi a aromo ne era neta diki beru be masanto aa ne pate be ka oso ne. Seena eke be ara azaati o eese be, nangka beyo nya pate aromo akwilǝ me masanto.
Nyimi a kangza bayana ee itǝ ana masanto a aromo, adorana nee laka teweno teying te rere ka eya ezame, aa ne sabe Ate aying ooka waya nyimi azaa shili.
O baala azaa makili
Tane laka na ma deya kang dinggi makili ma Mosa ka ewela ana obeya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili. Anta ma deya kang dinggi ne soona ang panza mai.
Eyang dongdong bele oying, azaa shili ka makeke maana yo maro, otengke o baate ewela makili ma Mosa wato maro ne, seeka a panza ekeeya apat.

A zaa nyimi pate ondooka wa cakate o yende o kala a bebaate a nyimi makili ma Ashili maana, aa wa baale ana ondo na neye nyimi, ayo beka ondo me na wa kala be baate a nyimia togomo te o zaa shili. Ondooka wa tare mai kangza aa wa baale ana ondo o tare o mai, ayo rara wai na ondo ogong a togomo te shili.
Eyang baalo ying eta kala ana obaala angmǝ ka Ashili anya Mosa ka maParisa aa eza epa e sangsang ne, eto lyǝ a togomo te ozaa shili ne.
O baala azaa lemunggi
“E kone obena a beka aromo ko rabo na, ‘Tano wong ondo ne, pate ondooka wa wongngha ondo, ayo gǝǝzǝ wai.’

Mi eyang bele oying, ondooka wa munggi ka arone wai, ayo gǝǝzǝ wai. Ondooka wa rare arone wai na, eta ka edang ne, ayo ale ka wai ara o cora angmǝ. Komana kangza wa rare arone wai na, eta ka edang ne, wa itǝ kap ka akwilǝ ola.
“Nyimia kangza, baya nya Ashili eyapa a nyimi akwilǝ ai ara o esaza Ashili mapapa ma owaze, o ringtǝ o bena arone au neye ka bo a lenyong,
baya epaaka oya nya Ashili a ting ara o esaza Ashili mapapa mo waze. Bora ka o ale ka o babare kane, o ama o de ka onya Ashili epaaka baaya nyame.

Ondo wa ale ka bo ara o cora angmǝ, yangkanna a saseya ka ebabare ka wai e tata o orona o ale zongka e dukǝ. Bata ya nyimi ne, wayo gwaarau ka ondoo cora angmǝ, aa ondoo cora angmǝ kangza wayo gwaarau ka ana o tesa geza ka a pateo a akwilǝ andaleme.
Ang dongdong bele o epeng, zongka o sǝǝrǝu arakaname, seena ba are pate emate eeka ataro.
O baala azaa leyau
“Ba kone a bekaana, ‘Tana o eze leyau ne.’
Eyang beya ying na, pate ondooka wa gonta ondaaye, kawa kone o eza leyau ka wai, wa samba o eza me ka wai naname a nyimi lenyong le wai.
Liizi le oree leo leeyo ote ka o rizi, lopa le ka o pere. Mara o dere sara yende a lepung leo ko bena a tare pate lepung leo a nyimi akwilǝ ola.
O ara oree wa ote ka o rizi, core wai ka o pere. Mara o dere sara yende a lepung leo ko bena a tare pate lepung leo a nyimi akwilǝ ola.
O baala azaa opere ondaaye
“Akang samba obena, ‘Ondooka wa pere ondaaye wai, awa dongdong nya wai ewela o pere o awai.
Aa maa bekaa ying na pate ondooka wa pere ondaaye wai, aa wata wa meke wai ka leyau ne, wa ote wai orona o leyau naname, kangza pate ondooka wa ana wai, wa eza leyau naname.
O baala azaa otono
“Kangza, ekone a samba o bekea aromo ko rabo na, ‘Tana o tono a rendaza ne, o eze epaaka ba tono ne aa begeshe Ateokora.’
Mi eyang beya yingna, tana e tono dakememe ne, ka azaa shili, obena arakanamea lǝdǝngdǝ le Ashili zene,
nyimia tane tono ka adeze ne, arakaname Ashili eeshe tobona te ai ne, koona ka Urushalima obena aya apeng ogomo ogong.
Kangza tana otono ka ukpwei o ne, azaa obena ba era ota ote lepkwai le yende kale itǝ leepeng koona leebo ne.
Pate epaaka wa gwara o beke belle eya ‘Eeye’ koona ‘Aa,’ eyapa e kala nyimi, e surea ara ondoo burua.
O baala azaa otaasa
“E kone a samba o bekaa me na, ‘Liizi a bengmǝ be liizi, a liini a bengmǝ be liini.’
Na mi eyang beya ying na, tana enyane ondoo eza oying epa eburu ne. Ondo wa tabau a letamo lo ore wanggare wai lo guri kawa tabe kangza.
Ondo wa ale ka bo ara o cora angmǝ ka wa jeke odibi o, nya wai ulǝ o urnǝzǝ o kangza.
A ondo wa oteu na o eze teweno te omele yende, o ale ka wai o mamele maleere.
Ondo wa bosa eyapa abo, o nya wai. Ondo kangza wa deya aa kope eyapa abo, tana o nare wai ne.
Oyeme ana onyana o
“E kone a samba o bekaa na, ‘Yeme ondooka waya ating o, o nyane ondooka wata yeme oo ne.’
A mi eyang beya aying na, yeme na ana o nyana oying e bosazana Ashili azaa andaaka ne gǝǝzǝ ying,
adorana e itǝ ayana Ate aying o zaa shili. Ondooka wa oteze ongme ka wa ye masanto ara ana edang kaa ana o dera edang, awa kang deesa ka olyi ara ana nyong a sangsang ka ana nyong a buru.
Ba yeme ana o yeme owa belle, aya taasa o ka eya? Ana o eesa emate makeke kaa ana madinǝ, nyimia ne ezeze.
Ba beeza aromo au okoo belle, eya o ezeze erere ke kala ena ondo? Andaame maYahuda taza ne nyimia ne ezeze.
Azaa nyimi, itǝ na ana edang nangka Ate aying o zaa shili waye ka edang.
